coverage: Field notebook offline media queue with real Web Crypto and injected storage/network: local type, signature, size and purpose checks; sealed per-item storage without bytes in the notebook; per-draft limit; lock/unlock survival; discard; upload only after sync with the item id as idempotency key and an identical body; lost response kept pending and retried with the same key; expired grant, confirmed visit, lost access, damaged copy and server refusal routed to review with nothing sent; temporary server failure kept pending; removal blocked while pending and deleting remaining media afterwards. Real IndexedDB, camera/microphone and service-worker behaviour are not tested here.
